title: HarvestXP
description: A lightweight farming plugin for Paper 26.1+ that adds XP rewards for harvesting crops with right-click support, auto-replanting, and fully configurable crop rewards.
body:
# HarvestXP
HarvestXP is a modern farming enhancement plugin for Paper 26.1+ that improves crop harvesting mechanics and adds rewarding progression through experience points.

Instead of breaking crops manually, players can simply right-click fully grown crops to harvest them instantly.

## ✨ Features
🌱 Right-click crop harvesting
🌾 Configurable XP rewards per crop
🔁 Auto replant system
🌍 Multi-language support (EN / RU included, expandable)
🧠 Smart anti-instant-harvest protection (including bone meal fixes)
✋ Smooth hand animation when harvesting
⚡ Lightweight and performance optimized

## ⚙️ Requirements
Paper 1.20+ (tested on Paper 26.1+)
Java 17+
